activity_summary: You came down before Mistress Ansell. Alse had the fire new and the soft side already decided, and she told you not to show that you knew. Gib was on the third tread. You waited, and you did not start on the loaf. From above, she told the room not to be clever yet.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Waited, and refused to start on the bread or the rolls.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Named the soft side, the tread, and the hour, and told him to look uninformed.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Called down that nobody was to be clever yet.

entities.name: the penny loaf
entities.context: Mentioned in Came down before Mistress Ansell

facets.activity: Came down to breakfast before the house was ready

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Set the board. I will wait for her mouth, not yours.
